biography.background:
« Rogue » est un Android Hacker spécialisé "Ghost", il utilise la technologie pour observer ses adversaires, se cacher, les attaquer depuis les ombres et introduire des virus dans leurs équipements, avant de les propager aux ennemis proches.

Comment jouer Rogue ?

  • Votre corps synthétique vous permez de survivre dans le vide de l'espace.

  • Le passé criminel de « Rogue » lui permet de négocier avec les scélérat et de trouver des planques.

  • Si un vous ou un allié faites une erreur, faites un restart avec @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.tBAeJc6NJtn47pdQ]{Hack Me Back In Time} !

  • Vos attaques permettent de trouver des failles et de provoquer une @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.y4cUUgwOuWBlzF1e]{Intrusion}, permettant d'effectuer encore plus de dégâts !

  • Utilisez vos cartes pour être prêt en toutes circonstances.

  • Piratez les terminaux informatiques pour trouver des informations utiles à votre mission !

system.description:
On a successful weapon attack or Tech domain attack, you can mark a Stress to breach into the target eletronic defenses and make the target Breached.

When you deal damage to a target you Breached, add 1d6 to the damage roll.

You can only have one Breached adversary at a time. This condition lasts until you take a rest or the adversary is defeated.
When your or an ally within Far range fails an action roll, you can Spend 3 Hope to change it into a success with Fear instead.
Hackers manipulate the battlefield through information warfare, cyber intrusion, and electronic disruption. They turn every piece of technology into a weapon.
You don't need to breathe and can survive the cold vacuum of space. You don't eat but must periodically recharge.
Once per Long Rest, reroll an Action Roll using Knowledge or Finesse.
You have advantage on rolls to negotiate with criminals, detect lies, or find a safe place to hide.

system.description: Your @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.y4cUUgwOuWBlzF1e]{Intrusion} feature now adds a number of d6s equal to your tier to the damage roll, instead of 1d6.
On a successful weapon attack on a Breached target, you can mark a Stress. to double the amount of Intrusion dice you roll.
Once per scene, immediately after damaging a creature, you may teleport into a shaded area within Far range.
The first time in a scene you succeed on an attack, clear a Stress or gain a Hope.
Your @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.y4cUUgwOuWBlzF1e]{Intrusion} feature now uses d8s instead of d6s.
Synthetic humanoids built with artificial bodies and genuine personalities. Androids are biomechanical constructs who typically resemble humanoids with glowing circuitry.
Play the Ghost if you want to exploit your Intrusions and your stalking to deal maximum damage to your target.
Being part of a slyborne community means you come from a group that operates outside the law, including all manner of criminals, grifters, and con artists.

Mark a Stress to boost the equipment of an ally within Close range or your own equipment. Apply one of these effects to your target:

  • Add 1d6 damage to the next successful attack made by the target with a primary weapon.

  • Grant +2 Evasion to the target until they are hit by an attack.

Spend a Hope to make a Spellcast Roll and conjure throwing blades that strike out at all targets within Very Close range. Targets you succeed against take d8+2 magic damage using your Proficiency.

If a target you hit is Vulnerable, they take an extra 1d8 damage.

A direct neural implant allowing instant interaction with nearby technology.
You don't need any lighter for as long as you have batteries.

Three times per rest, you can activate the tactical scan to detect signs of life and movement within a Far range around you. You know the general direction, general distance and approximate size of the life forms.
